build.beforeDevCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -f index.html ]; then ROOT=.; elif [ -f ../index.html ]; then ROOT=..; else echo "index.html not found"; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$ROOT/dist"; cp "$ROOT/index.html" "$ROOT/dist/index.html"'
build.beforeBuildCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -f index.html ]; then ROOT=.; elif [ -f ../index.html ]; then ROOT=..; else echo "index.html not found"; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$ROOT/dist"; cp "$ROOT/index.html" "$ROOT/dist/index.html"'
